title: ATX Transit Visions, I-35 Caps Cost
summary:
*   Austin is moving forward with vision plans for the North Lamar and South Congress transit centers, aiming to create equitable, connected communities with mixed-income housing and local businesses.
*   These new land use guidelines for transit areas prioritize preventing displacement but do not immediately change zoning; future regulatory tools are expected.
*   A new financial study reveals that proposed I-35 "Cap and Stitch" projects will not generate enough revenue to cover their high construction and significant annual maintenance costs.
*   Funding decisions for the I-35 caps face hurdles due to limited private investment precedents and existing downtown zones that capture potential tax revenue.
